security_audit.summary: Most static matches are false positives caused by Markdown fences, relative documentation links, and email-client terminology. Two operational behaviors remain: an optional live render-test email command and a user-confirmed local result save; neither shows malicious intent, but both require confirmation and path validation.

remediation.issue: Optional live render-test sends can create an external side effect.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation immediately before any command using --live, display the sender and recipient inboxes, and enforce an allowlist of user-owned test recipients.

remediation.issue: The save path includes a subject-derived filename.
remediation.suggestion: Normalize the subject to a safe slug, reject path separators and traversal sequences, and resolve the final path within the designated memory directory before writing.

content.user_title: Build responsive email HTML with render QA
content.value_statement: Email HTML can fail across clients, dark mode, and image-off settings. This skill creates table-based builds and documents rendering, accessibility, and plain-text checks.
actual_capabilities: Creates single-column, table-based email HTML from approved creative.
Recommends responsive layout patterns for Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, and mobile clients.
Checks dark-mode color pairs, image-off fallbacks, and bulletproof CTA requirements.
Produces an accessibility checklist for alt text, reading order, language, contrast, and mobile font size.
Builds a client-render matrix that distinguishes estimated results from measured tests.
Compares HTML and plain-text content for message, CTA, and destination parity.
limitations: It does not write or revise email marketing copy.
It cannot claim measured rendering without a real seed or preview test.
It does not replace ESP-specific validation or paid rendering-preview services.
Live render-test sends require an approved sender, user-owned test inboxes, and explicit confirmation.

use_cases.title: Build a promotion email
use_cases.description: Turn approved campaign copy into a responsive table-based email with a clear CTA and image-off fallbacks.

use_cases.title: Repair an Outlook layout
use_cases.description: Review supplied email HTML and identify table, dark-mode, or image fallback changes for Outlook and other target clients.

use_cases.title: Prepare a newsletter handoff
use_cases.description: Create a render matrix, accessibility checklist, and plain-text parity notes before ESP delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic email build
prompt_templates.prompt: Build responsive email HTML from this approved subject, preheader, body, CTA, and destination URL: [paste creative]. Use a single-column table layout.

prompt_templates.title: Check client rendering
prompt_templates.prompt: QA this email HTML for Gmail, Outlook desktop and web, Apple Mail, iOS, and Android. List dark-mode, image-off, and responsive risks as Estimated unless tested: [paste HTML].

prompt_templates.title: Fix a rendering issue
prompt_templates.prompt: This email breaks in Outlook and loses meaning when images are off. Revise the supplied HTML with table-safe structure, bulletproof CTAs, and fallbacks. Keep the approved copy unchanged: [paste HTML].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an audited handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Build and QA this newsletter from the approved creative. Return HTML, a client-render matrix, accessibility results, image-off notes, and a plain-text alternate with matching CTA and destination: [paste creative].

output_examples.input: Approved promotion copy, CTA, destination URL, and brand colors.
output: Plain-text alternate with matching CTA and URL

output_examples.input: Existing email HTML that fails in Outlook.
output: Estimated rendering status for each requested client

output_examples.input: Newsletter HTML without a plain-text version.
output: Plain-text alternate that preserves the core message
Parity check for the primary CTA and destination URL

best_practices: Provide approved copy, the destination URL, target clients, and brand constraints before requesting a build.
Treat untested client behavior as estimated and verify critical sends with user-owned seed inboxes.
Keep the plain-text message, CTA, and destination aligned with the HTML version.
anti_patterns: Do not use image-only offers or CTA buttons that disappear when images are blocked.
Do not present support-matrix expectations as measured rendering results.
Do not ask this skill to rewrite approved marketing copy or score campaign quality.

faq.question: Does this skill write email copy?
faq.answer: No. It uses approved copy to build and QA the HTML email.

faq.question: Which email clients does it cover?
faq.answer: It supports QA guidance for Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, iOS Mail, and Android clients.

faq.question: Can it verify real rendering?
faq.answer: Only with a real seed or preview test. Otherwise it labels results as estimated.

faq.question: Does it handle dark mode?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks foreground and background colors and documents dark-mode rendering risks.

faq.question: Can it send a test email?
faq.answer: It can document an optional render-test command for supported ESP setups. A live send needs explicit confirmation and user-owned test inboxes.

faq.question: Does it create a plain-text version?
faq.answer: Yes. It can produce or compare a plain-text alternate for message, CTA, and destination parity.
